name: Venice Timbalier Extension
monitor_reason: scope/status: a completed 1997 line now being retired, not a new project; no second source names it
researcher_notes: Not an existing GEM row: P5519 is the Texas Eastern Venice Extension Project, a different line (3 mi, 42 in, proposed). No GEM gas row names Venice Gathering System. The EIA August 2026 release, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2024)', Excel row 58, lists Venice Timbalier Extension, operator Venice Gas Gathering System LL, New Pipeline, Completed 1997-11, FERC docket CP97-533, cost 39.1 million dollars, 52 miles, 328 MMcf/d, 24 in. That is the only source that names the line, and EIA is one origin. The Federal Register shows the operator, Venice Gathering System LLC, got authority to abandon in place a 28.9 mile 20-inch lateral between South Timbalier 265 and South Timbalier 151 in 2011 (docket CP11-58). In 2024 it applied to abandon in place the whole system, about 121.5 miles of 8 to 26 inch pipe (docket CP24-93). Neither notice names the Timbalier Extension, so its link to a specific segment, its length, and its current status are not confirmed. Length of 52 miles passes the 25 km rule, but there is no forward step: the line was built long ago and appears to be retired or being retired. If GEM wants retired historical lines, the better record is the Venice Gathering System as a whole, with its FERC dockets, after the FERC abandonment order is read. Nothing found on whether the 2024 abandonment was approved. Owner not styled because no row is proposed.
